verdict.rationale: Recurring scheduled jobs are a plausible capability for a managed data platform like Pinecone (e.g., scheduled backups or imports), so the axis applies. The evidence only shows one-off actions such as creating backups or managing indexes via the console, SDK or MCP. It never mentions a recurring schedule, cron or workflow scheduler.
